contexts.text: The Lord endured all temptations by His own power.
That He endured the most grievous temptations, as if they were from the Divine. Signified. (For) my soul is delivered = to endure... the Divine presence.

(For) the evils and falsities in man, tempered with the goods and truths in him, cannot endure a closer presence... Evil Spirits cannot endure that Angels should look into them... Hell is remote from Heaven, because it endures not Heaven, that is, the Lord's presence which is in Heaven.
(No infernal can endure the presence of a celestial Angel.)
The evil do not endure the presence of those who are in celestial good.
That the Lord alone endures the combats of temptations. Signified. AC 8219.
No Angel can endure the flame from the Divine love. AC 8760:end.
That those who are solely in the externals of the Church... do not endure interior things. Signified.
A thousand foes there do not endure one ray of the light of Heaven.
They were permitted to perceive heavenly joy to such a degree that they could not endure any more...
Thou canst not bear the evil = that they do not endure evils to be called goods, and the reverse.
Thou hast endured, and thou hast endurance () = patience with them. ( = resistance against those who attack the truths of faith, and assiduity in instructing. AE 101.)
No Angel... endures the Lord's presence itself...
That the Lord alone has endured all the evils of the Church, and all the violence done to the Word, thus to Himself. Signified.
They endured not [to hear] the explanation.
Some said that they could not endure the joy of the happiness.
He endures not to hear the goods of love and the truths of doctrine.
